checkB_scout_floor4.note: SHARP reader's read of floor 4 (The Ascending Dark) from the threshold, by the carried core's dim glow — WITHOUT springing the Stalker's dark-ambush (careful + partial light; never commits up unlit). GRASPS the puzzle: LIGHT FIRST, then footing/timing. Does NOT see the Counterweight Colossus (headworks/top) or the snagged corpse+note (mid-shaft) — those are deeper in. No ambush triggered; he can prepare/withdraw.
